description: When a provider or model hits org spend-limit or quota exhaustion, concurrent preflight probes and resumes repeatedly launch containers against the dead provider instead of sharing a short-circuit cooldown marker.
goal: Record and consult a shared host-level provider cooldown marker (under ~/.holon/ with reset/TTL timestamp) via apps/sandbox-executor/src/sandbox_executor/preflight_cooldown.py (new), apps/sandbox-executor/src/sandbox_executor/cli/preflight.py, apps/sandbox-executor/src/sandbox_executor/preflight.py, and apps/sandbox-executor/src/sandbox_executor/preflight_outage.py when preflight detects org spend-limit or quota exhaustion so concurrent launches and checkpoint resumes short-circuit immediately while the cooldown is active without re-probing the exhausted provider. Keep preflight.py within its 548-line cap, all other modules within 350 lines, and holon-config/hygiene/module_budgets.json untouched, and preserve all existing preflight_gate and run_preflight_probe public signatures/behavior when no active cooldown marker exists. Add hermetic unit tests in apps/sandbox-executor/tests/test_preflight.py, apps/sandbox-executor/tests/test_preflight_outage.py, and apps/sandbox-executor/tests/test_preflight_retries.py using isolated temp HOME/state paths verifying cooldown recording, TTL expiry, and short-circuit failure. Code is self-explaining: no docstrings and no comments except '# why:' comments that record a reason the code cannot show.
rationale: Short-circuiting repeated preflight probes against a provider known to be in spend-limit or quota cooldown eliminates minutes of wasted container startups across concurrent flows.
acceptance_criteria: A shared host-level provider cooldown marker (under `~/.holon/` with reset/TTL timestamp, implemented in preflight_cooldown.py, cli/preflight.py, preflight.py, and preflight_outage.py) is recorded when preflight fails with org spend-limit or quota exhaustion, so concurrent launches and checkpoint resumes fail fast without re-probing the exhausted provider while its cooldown is active.

Hermetic unit tests in apps/sandbox-executor/tests/test_preflight.py, apps/sandbox-executor/tests/test_preflight_outage.py, and apps/sandbox-executor/tests/test_preflight_retries.py verify cooldown marker write, expiry, and fast-fail behaviour (keeping preflight.py within 548 lines and holon-config/hygiene/module_budgets.json untouched) under `uv run pytest` and `uv run task lint`, and code is self-explaining (no docstrings; only '# why:' comments).
